start.title: Sons of the Soil
start.text:
You are Cain, firstborn of Adam.
Your brother Abel walks beside you in the dawn.

choices.feedback: He smiles. The morning feels lighter.

choices.text: Compare yourself to him in silence
choices.feedback: A quiet bitterness takes root.
He calls your name. You do not turn.

fields.title: The Tiller of Soil
fields.text:
The earth resists your hoe.
Sweat. Stones. The long hours of work.

choices.feedback: The labor settles your heart.

choices.text: Curse the ground as you dig
choices.feedback: Each strike grows angrier than the last.

abel_pasture.title: Your Brother's Flock
abel_pasture.text:
Abel rests among his sheep, content.
A newborn lamb sleeps on his chest.

choices.text: Be glad for his gentle work
choices.feedback: Warmth rises where envy could have grown.

choices.text: Resent that his work seems easy
choices.feedback: Your jaw tightens. Comparison poisons the day.
Your words stay quiet, but they sting your own soul.

offerings.title: Before the Altar
offerings.text:
It is time to bring an offering to the Lord.
What will you give?

choices.feedback: You choose the finest grain. Your heart is open.
Wilted stalks. Half a thought toward heaven.
Empty hands. A harder, prouder heart.

accepted.title: The Lord's Favor
accepted.text:
The Lord receives Abel's lamb with joy.
Your offering — He does not regard.

choices.feedback: You ask why. The answer is already in you.
Heat floods your chest. He becomes your enemy.
Your fist rises. The sky does not answer.

anger.title: Why Are You Angry?
anger.text:
Your face falls. Your hands shake.
The Lord asks: "Why are you angry?"

choices.text: Lay your anger down before Him
choices.feedback: The fire begins to cool. Honesty opens a path.
You hide your face. He still sees.

warning.title: Sin Crouches at the Door
warning.text:
"Sin is crouching at your door.
Its desire is for you — but you must master it."

choices.feedback: You exhale. You will choose differently.
You open the door wide. Sin walks in.
The warning fades. The hatred remains.

invitation.title: Come With Me to the Field
invitation.text:
Abel walks toward you, trusting.
His face is open. Yours is not.

choices.text: Tell him the truth of your heart
choices.feedback: Words are hard. But honesty is mercy.

choices.text: Lure him alone into the field
choices.feedback: Your voice is calm. Your intent is not.

field.title: In the Field
field.text:
The field is empty. No one will see.
Anger surges. A stone is in your hand.

choices.feedback: It falls heavy at your feet. You breathe again.
One blow. Then silence. Then horror.
Your hand obeys the rage. The field receives him.

confrontation.title: "Where Is Your Brother?"
confrontation.text:
The voice of the Lord finds you.
"Where is your brother Abel?"

choices.text: Confess what your hands have done
choices.feedback: The truth crushes you. And begins to free you.
The lie tastes like ash in your mouth.

choices.text: Stay silent and hide your eyes
choices.feedback: His blood cries out from the ground.

wanderer.title: East of Eden, Marked
wanderer.text:
The Lord places a mark to protect you.
You must wander far from home.
